paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Fine-tuned LLaMA & Mistral in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini
model_annotation: This chart represents the win rates of different models in terms of empathetic responses, with the models being compared visually displayed in a donut chart. The chart is divided into four slices, each representing a different model. The slices are labeled with the model names, including GPT-4o (dark blue, 12.0% and light blue, 19.6%), Mistral (beige, 88.0%), and LLaMA (light blue-green, 80.4%). The percentages are displayed outside the chart, connected to their respective slices by lines, and are also shown inside the chart next to the corresponding labels for the inner ring. The chart appears to be comparing the win rates of GPT-4o against fine-tuned LLaMA and Mistral models. The slices are not ordered in any particular size-based sequence, and some slices are visually distinguished by different shades of blue and other colors.
